mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation (id, user_id, title) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = IF(user_id = VALUES(user_id) AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, VALUES(title), title)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM agent_conversation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT message, report FROM agent_run WHERE conversation_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND report IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (id, conversation_id, user_id, project_id, message, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{message}, 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, project_id, message, status, report, lead_ids, created_at, finished_at FROM agent_run WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET report = #{report} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'AWAITING_REVIEW' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AWAITING_REVIEW'
UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_run SET lead_ids = CONCAT_WS(',', lead_ids, #{leadId}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tool_log (run_id, node, tool, args_summary, result_summary, status, duration_ms) VALUES (#{runId}, #{node}, #{tool}, #{argsSummary}, #{resultSummary}, #{status}, #{durationMs})

INSERT INTO crm_lead_score (run_id, enterprise_id, project_id, total_score, industry_score, region_score, scale_score, signal_score, completeness_score, grade, source_type, reasons, duplicate_lead_id, fit_score, intent_score, confidence_score, score_model_version) VALUES (#{runId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{projectId}, #{totalScore}, #{industryScore}, #{regionScore}, #{scaleScore}, #{signalScore}, #{completenessScore}, #{grade}, #{sourceType}, #{reasons}, #{duplicateLeadId}, #{fitScore}, #{intentScore}, #{confidenceScore}, 'V2')
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, node, tool, args_summary, result_summary, status, duration_ms, created_at FROM agent_tool_log WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id

SELECT s.id, s.run_id, s.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, s.project_id, s.total_score, s.industry_score, s.region_score, s.scale_score, s.signal_score, s.completeness_score, s.fit_score, s.intent_score, s.confidence_score, s.score_model_version, s.grade, s.source_type, s.reasons, s.duplicate_lead_id, s.created_at FROM crm_lead_score s LEFT JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = s.enterprise_id WHERE s.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY s.total_score DESC, s.id
